jake_sales: Quick transfer — SparkPoint (midmarket) signed. Start date 2024-06-01. Main risk: SSO + data residency questions. Passing to @maria_cs for onboarding + @sam_support for infra questions. Contract: 1yr reserved capacity. Docs: https://rwd.internal/contracts/SP-2024

maria_cs: Thanks @jake_sales — taking lead. Can you drop the SSO details and the engineer contact?

jake_sales: SSO is Okta OIDC; SP needs PII redaction for logs. Eng contact: @raj_engineer. API usage estimate ~ 600k tokens/mo. Attached PoC notes in docs above.

maria_cs: Noted. Action items:
1) Kickoff call (owner: maria_cs)
2) SSO test plan (owner: raj_engineer)
3) Private deployment feasibility (owner: sam_support)
4) Eval prompt set for quality baseline (owner: anya_csm)
I'll schedule kickoff for week of May 6.

anya_csm: I'll build the eval set — need typical user flows. @jake_sales pls share 3 sample prompts.

jake_sales: Sharing 3 samples in thread: ```How do I reset my billing?
Find product specs for model X
Can you summarize last invoice?```

raj_engineer: OK I'll own SSO test plan. Need Okta org ID and test user creds. @maria_cs please share via secure Slack DM or vault.

sam_support: Private deployment checklist — we need customer subnet & KMS details. Estimate 2 weeks once creds + infra greenlight. Flagging dependency: security review with infra team.

maria_cs: I'll request Okta creds and subnet info today. Also flagging renewal risk: usage projection vs reserved capacity — finance may need to adjust commit. @liz_product FYI for optimization recs.

liz_product: We can propose batching + 8-bit quant for cost. Will prepare a one-pager for kickoff.

maria_cs: Thanks. Can everyone add status reactions to the items? I'll send calendar invite once I have availability. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder: create Support ticket #SP-1245 for private deploy requests — assigned to sam_support.

sam_support: Ticket created #SP-1245. I'll update when infra review scheduled.
